description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W} or by tapping a white creature.
Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion spell.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
